hook: The macOS kernel, loaded as a Linux module

beats.say: xnulinux builds XNU, the open-source macOS kernel, from Apple's sources and loads it as a kernel module inside an unmodified arm64 Linux.
On a stock Ubuntu kernel, one insmod boots a macOS 27 disk all the way to the desktop, with Finder, the Dock, Safari and Chrome.
There's no hypervisor. macOS processes run natively beside Linux ones, while a small module lends XNU Linux's memory, files, network and GPU.
